title: See numbers to 5
summary: See how many in a quick look, and match dice back to fingers.
subject: maths

difficultyRamp.within: Q1 and Q2 flash dice 1 and 5 quickly. Q3 shows 5 fingers. Q4 sees 3 and 2 in all. Q5 matches dice to fingers. Q6 sees 4 and 1. Q7 picks a group of 3. Q8 hides 5. Q9 matches 1 finger to dice. Q10 types 3.
difficultyRamp.versus: Easy uses long flashes and clear 2 and 3. Medium shortens the flash and mixes arrangements. Hard uses a quicker flash and reverse matching. Hard is a new kind of thinking, not just bigger numbers.
